dialogues.speaker: Guilan
dialogues.text: Step right up and take a look! Play a round of "Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won" and ring in a year of good luck!

response.speaker: Guilan
response.text: Alright! This way, please. We'll get started right away!

choices.text: I've got something else to do...

response.speaker: Guilan
response.text: Sure, no problem. Feel free to come back any time if you want to play.
